review_scope: Complete Rigellian entry, records 4 through 32; cross-culture mentions in 64, 134 and 175 also read

summary: Ancient confederated culture; sophisticated, historically conscious and interested in other cultures.
Tall slender long-limbed species; elegant movement and manual dexterity.
Can tolerate atmospheres except pure oxygen and temporarily cease breathing; this does not prove buildings are unsealed.
Complex variable reproductive biology; no physical construction rule is established.
Long lifespan and strong natural resistance to illness; no named construction material is established.
Ergonomic and elegant architecture, including mining equipment.
Comfortable by Terran standards, less luxurious than Artemian architecture.
Research facilities are common and used by miners as well as specialists.
Highly educated and politically sophisticated confederation; strong opposition to biowarfare.
Historically motivated preference for political unity; governance can be secretive.
Knowledge and its proper use are central values rather than an established religion.
Advanced warp technology once gave an advantage; warfare and tactics are not primary cultural strengths.

authoring_decisions: Integrate functional components into deliberate, elegant body divisions, including the universal Extractor.
Retain source-supported slender stacked structures, polished silhouettes and restrained fittings; do not add indiscriminate armour, spikes, skulls or religious motifs.

No exact alloy or mandatory material is named in the reviewed Rigellian entry. Green, bronze and pale-metal appearances come from correctly paletted object graphics; exact alloy identity remains inferred.
Treat green colour alone as insufficient evidence of a pipe. Preserve unknown function of ambiguous inset/casing details.
Lifespan supports durable equipment as context, not an assertion of a particular wear pattern or material.
Vehicle application of architectural guidance remains a contextual interpretation, not recovered hull geometry.
priority: Visible missing components and structural fidelity, not micro-detail scoring.
